mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.75%) reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.75%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.7% signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: Expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 103.5) indicates rising manufacturing capacity utilization, supporting corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 103.5.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm employment (PAYEMS > 145000) indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 145000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 103.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.7) and increase in employment (PAYEMS > 145000) signals accelerating labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.7 and PAYEMS > 145000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1100) supports consumer wealth and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in a housing-driven demand regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1100.
